evals.prompt: Set up recurring monitoring for three competitors in the German digital insurance space: Clark, Getsafe, and Feather. Watch for pricing changes, new product launches, and messaging shifts.
evals.expected_output: A monitoring plan with scope (entities, fields), cadence, baseline recommendation, and alert thresholds. Must distinguish between high-signal changes (pricing, new products) and low-signal noise (blog posts, minor copy edits). Must mention that monitoring is a separate skill, not part of evidence-scout.

evals.prompt: Track web traffic for my top 5 competitors using Similarweb data. Give me monthly reports.
evals.expected_output: A traffic-monitoring plan with approval gate for paid traffic actors (Similarweb-style). Must note that traffic estimates and bounce rates are not proof of churn or demand — they are competitive context only. Must recommend specific metrics and warn against over-interpreting estimates.

evals.prompt: Monitor local competitors — we run a chain of coffee shops in Berlin and want to track new openings, rating trends, and review sentiment.
evals.expected_output: A local-monitoring plan using Google Maps actors. Must require explicit user approval before running location-based actors. Must note that ratings and review counts are context unless repeated review text shows real pain or competitive weakness. Must recommend review-text analysis over rating averages.
